```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-cube-vs-path
#| fig-cap: "Tree + CoordPath vs Tree + CoordCube: direct comparison on CoordSpaceN2 tree (D=2 R=1 radius=1, 9 paths). Tree+Path: 9 sequential get_by_coordkey at 159 ns. Tree+Cube dense: proximity r=1 at 287 ns — BoundingBoxIter + Vec push overhead makes it 1.8x slower. Tree+Cube sparse (9 entries): 48 ns — 3.3x faster with fewer tree nodes and zero Vec overhead. Path gen only (empty tree): 15.4 ns baseline."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

ops = [
    'Path gen\n(empty tree)',
    'Tree+Path\n(seq 9 keys)',
    'Tree+Cube\ndense 10K',
    'Tree+Cube\nsparse 9',
]

times = [15.4, 159.0, 287.0, 48.0]
edges = ['black'] * 4
hatches = ['', '\\\\', '...', 'ooo']

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))
bars = ax.bar(range(len(ops)), times, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch=hatches)

ax.set_xticks(range(len(ops)))
ax.set_xticklabels(ops, fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel('ns (lower is better)')
ax.set_ylim(0, 340)

for bar, val in zip(bars, times):
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 8,
            f'{val} ns', ha='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# Ratio annotations (no arrows)
ax.annotate('1.8x slower\n(overhead)', xy=(2, 287), xytext=(2, 170),
            fontsize=7.5, ha='center',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.9))

ax.annotate('3.3x faster\n(no overhead)', xy=(3, 48), xytext=(3, 120),
            fontsize=8, ha='center', fontweight='bold',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.9))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
